case: Explicitly typed text parameter for a domain-over-enum array
contract: An explicitly cast text parameter decodes as a domain-over-enum array containing the literal label NULL, empty text, Unicode, a comma-containing label, and SQL NULL.
The full driver result, array_to_json, pg_typeof and array_send bytes exactly match an independently constructed native PostgreSQL array.
An invalid array element is rejected by PostgreSQL with SQLSTATE 22P02.

focused_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract::value_contract_domain_over_enum_array_preserves_labels_and_null -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other custom enum array consumers, session configurations and spreadsheet-application re-import remain open.
